sentence: This project studies how more information about older adults with multiple chronic conditions can help balance the risks of lowering blood pressure.
This project uses long-read sequencing and computational modeling to study how transposable element insertions change chromatin and gene expression in the human genome.
This project studies RNA modifications in platelets after injury to find biomarkers and targets for preventing organ failure.
This project supplies ovarian cancer models in mice, and 3D cultures of tumors, for research on improving the treatment of ovarian cancer.
This project studies how a system that tunes a developmental signal between cells is linked to birth defects.
This project studies how enzymes edit RNA and looks for ways to control that editing.
This project builds a catheter that gives higher backup force and support in a smaller profile to simplify heart procedures.
This project builds 3D gut models with vasculature to study how human immune cells respond to parasites.
This project uses a 3-dimensional organoid co-culture model to find out what causes abnormalities in neuronal connectivity seen in HIV-associated neurocognitive disorders.
This project studies whether changing stress signaling targets could impair tumor growth in glioblastoma, a type of brain tumor.
This project uses electroencephalogram recordings in mouse models of Fragile X Syndrome to find biomarkers that also appear in patients.
This project studies how two large groups of Epstein Barr virus RNA help cause tumors in lymphomas.
This project studies how clocks in the intestine are organized in response to light and food and how disrupting them contributes to disease.
This project makes viral vectors and helps researchers generate transgenic animal models.
This project provides behavioral assays for rodents and humans to support translational research.
This project maps specialized RNA structures called G-quadruplexes and uses machine learning to find small molecules that stabilize them in patient-derived neurons.
This project uses clinical data and machine-learning methods to predict risk of recurrent acute mental health episodes among midlife women.
This project studies how proteins that bind copper control muscle development and how copper imbalance contributes to disease.
This project uses clinical data to find what drives incisional hernia and builds models to predict hernia risk in surgery patients.
This project studies how a virus protein matures in the Golgi apparatus to find a broad antiviral mechanism.
